mapper.select: SELECT user_id,data_source FROM user_info WHERE user_id IN #{id}

SELECT a.article_id,a.title,a.content,a.content_type,a.update_time,a.cover_image,a.view_count,a.like_count, a.user_id,a.category_id,a.publish_time,u.nick_name AS author_name, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(t.tag_name) FROM article_tag_relation r JOIN article_tag t ON t.tag_id=r.tag_id WHERE r.article_id=a.article_id) AS current_tags FROM article_info a LEFT JOIN user_info u ON a.user_id=u.user_id WHERE a.status=1 AND a.deleted=0 AND a.required_level=0 AND a.article_id IN #{id}
SELECT tag_name FROM article_tag WHERE tag_name IN #{n}
SELECT category_id,category_name FROM category WHERE category_name IN #{n}
SELECT user_id,nick_name FROM user_info WHERE nick_name=#{name} LIMIT 2

SELECT article_id,title,summary,create_time,view_count,like_count,collect_count FROM article_info WHERE user_id=#{uid} AND status=1 AND deleted=0 AND required_level=0 ORDER BY create_time DESC,article_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.content,u.nick_name,c.create_time FROM comment c JOIN user_info u ON c.user_id=u.user_id JOIN article_info a ON a.article_id=c.article_id WHERE c.article_id=#{aid} AND c.status=0 AND a.status=1 AND a.deleted=0 AND a.required_level=0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT tag_name,use_count FROM article_tag ORDER BY use_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT article_id FROM article_info WHERE article_id>#{cursor} ORDER BY article_id LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM article_info WHERE article_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_index_outbox WHERE article_id=#{id} AND status IN ('pending','running','dispatched','dead')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_view_sync(article_id,target_count,available_at) VALUES(#{id},#{count},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_count=GREATEST(target_count,VALUES(target_count)),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS count FROM article_index_outbox GROUP BY status
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,created_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))),0) FROM article_index_outbox WHERE status IN ('pending','dispatched','running')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM article_index_outbox WHERE (status='completed' AND updated_at<TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,-30,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) OR (status='dead' AND updated_at<TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,-90,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) LIMIT 500
mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id FROM reading_session s LEFT JOIN user_reading_progress p ON p.user_id=s.user_id WHERE s.last_heartbeat<TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,-30,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (p.active_session IS NULL OR p.active_session<>s.session_id) ORDER BY s.last_heartbeat LIMIT 500
mapper.delete: DELETE s FROM reading_session s LEFT JOIN user_reading_progress p ON p.user_id=s.user_id WHERE s.session_id IN #{id} AND s.last_heartbeat<TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,-30,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (p.active_session IS NULL OR p.active_session<>s.session_id)
DELETE FROM article_read_receipt WHERE read_day<DATE_SUB(UTC_DATE(),INTERVAL 2 DAY) LIMIT 500
